title: my-copilot and copilot-api: operations
description: Ingress, login, platform, logs and traces for apps in namespace copilot.

list.label: Metrics
list.name: DS_METRICS
list.description: Mimir data source with X-Scope-OrgID tenant. This dashboard belongs in the Grafana that reads the tenant org.

list.label: Logs
list.name: DS_LOGS
list.description: Loki data source with X-Scope-OrgID tenant. This dashboard belongs in the Grafana that reads the tenant org.

list.label: Traces
list.name: DS_TRACES
list.description: Tempo data source with X-Scope-OrgID tenant. This dashboard belongs in the Grafana that reads the tenant org.

panels.title: Requests by host
panels.description: From the nais-ingress access log in tenant Loki. Replaces the nginx metrics, which exist in neither org.

targets.expr: sum by (class) (count_over_time({service_namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", service_name="nais-ingress"} | json | label_format class=`{{ substr 0 1 .http_response_status_code }}xx` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Responses by status class
panels.description: Status classes from the nais-ingress access log.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", service_name="nais-ingress"} | json | unwrap request_time [$__auto]) by (url_domain)

panels.title: Response time p95 by host
panels.description: request_time in the access log is in milliseconds.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", service_name="nais-ingress"} | json | unwrap upstream_response_length [$__auto]) by (url_domain)

sum by (container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", resource="cpu", container!=""})

panels.title: Postgres instances up
panels.description: Instances per CNPG cluster whose metrics collector reports up. Each cluster runs 2 instances (primary and replica).

panels.title: Connections vs max_connections
panels.description: Highest share of max_connections in use on any instance of the cluster.

targets.expr: max by (postgres) (sum by (postgres, pod) (cnpg_pg_stat_activity_count{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env"}) / on (postgres, pod) max by (postgres, pod) (cnpg_pg_settings_setting{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", name="max_connections"})) >= 0

panels.title: Replication lag
panels.description: Seconds the replica is behind the primary.

panels.title: Transactions/s
panels.description: Commits and rollbacks per second in the app database, all instances.

targets.expr: sum by (postgres) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_xact_commit{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", datname="app"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_xact_rollback{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", datname="app"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Deadlocks
panels.description: Deadlocks detected in the app database per interval.

panels.title: Backup age
panels.description: Seconds since the newest available backup, from barman_cloud_cloudnative_pg_io_last_available_backup_timestamp. Red above 36 h, matching the Nais stale-backup alert. Nais backs up with the Barman Cloud plugin, so the cnpg_collector backup metrics are always 0. No data means no backup reported.

panels.title: WAL archiving failures
panels.description: Failed WAL archive attempts per interval. A failure is current when the last failure is newer than the last successful archive: the second series is then above 0, in seconds.
